verdict.rationale: The Washington Department of Revenue holds sensitive taxpayer data through its My DOR system, so whether that data can be excluded from AI-model training is a fair privacy-posture question. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions AI training, data-use policies, or any opt-out control. The pages cover only licensing, tax filing and payments, and the probes show only missing machine-readable endpoints and a login wall.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
